Application called WordNote designed for taking notes (tasks). WordNote allows to customize note / task so as required by the user, due to the capabilities of the WYSIWYG editor: insert a picture, highlight text in bold / italics, change the text size and color, add a clickable link to an external resource, make / remove the indentation, highlight the text as a quote to add to the list or numbered markers, insert a separator and clear all formatting, and set notifications for a given date / time and change the priority tasks.
 Developer: Alox1d (Baranov A.Y.) Ⓒ 2020 Used libraries: 
 https://github.com/irshuLx/Android-WYSIWYG-Editor 
 https://github.com/QuadFlask/colorpicker 
 https://github.com/hdodenhof/CircleImageView DateParser 
Contacts:

To add a note after the splash screen, click "+" button in the lower right corner. Next, after the opening of the dialogue fill in the required field application, and, if required, enter a description (It can execute using formatting buttons at the bottom of the screen) select the date / time reminder note and its priority. Click "OK" to confirm. \ n If necessary, edit the note - click on it. \ n To switch between lists "done" and "current" notes follow swipe left or right, respectively, or click on the desired category on the screen. \ n To mark a task as completed, click on the circle on the left side of the note title. A similar action is required to move the notes from the list made in the current. \ n To search the notes use with a corresponding field with magnifying glass at the top of the screen. \ n To disable / enable the splash screen, select the appropriate option from the menu. 
 For using backup, press "sync" button at the top-right corner. 
 For voice-input, press "mic" button at the end of the note title on the add/edit note dialog. 
 For OCR image text, press "camera" button at the bottom of editor toolbar on the add/edit note dialog.
